result.reason: The operative language covers Company affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and makes the royalty-free perpetual licence irrevocable. Transferability is limited to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or substantially all-assets sale, which meets the fallback rather than the broader preferred successor-transfer position. Subscription termination is not relevant to this perpetual grant. The added “worldwide” scope is not required by the playbook, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Unrelated commercial intent is otherwise preserved. Drafting quality is reduced by the awkward parenthetical and the uncorrected errors “non- exclusive” and “create, derivative version.”
